I will keep the usual wheat-maize rotation. In Quzhou County, that is the steadiest way for me to use the land, spread labor across the year, and protect my income. I am 59, so I do not want a complicated mix of crops that needs too much special management or risky market timing. I will finish the winter wheat already in the field with steady water and fertilizer, then I will follow it immediately with summer maize. I will use improved wheat seed and hybrid maize seed because I care more about stable yield than saving a little on seed. I will fertilize enough to secure production, irrigate when the crop really needs it, spray only as needed for the main diseases, insects, and weeds, and use simpler field operations to save labor and time.
